clips.title: The story
paras: Mankrik turns his grief at the Crossroads into a campaign against the Bristleback quilboar. The orc was separated from his wife in a violent ambush, and now he calls on Horde travelers to kill the creatures and bring back their tusks.

Mankrik carries the grief of a quilboar ambush that left him battered and his wife missing. At the Crossroads, he watches the arid horizon, still thirsting for the blood of the Bristlebacks despite the many he has killed himself. He calls on fellow Horde travelers to help him continue the fight.

Mankrik demands sixty Bristleback quilboar tusks. Each one is a measure of suffering returned to the creatures that tore his life apart. The trophies cannot heal his grief or end his desire for revenge, but seeing the Bristlebacks bleed brings the wounded warrior a fleeting, bitter satisfaction.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Perhaps you know the pain of uncertainty, perhaps not, adventurer. But know this: I stand here every day, from the sun's rising till its decline, scouring the horizon for more of those monsters. I've killed every pig man I've come across since, but my thirst for their blood is far from quenched. Perhaps instead of heading north to the Crossroads I should have headed to Taurajo.
Kill them. Kill as many as you can. Bring me their tusks, and we will celebrate their deaths together.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The quilboar will pay for this, friend. I swear it.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Adventurer, you take my task seriously, and for that I thank you.
Although my desire for revenge remains, I can at least smile seeing that the quilboars have felt pain themselves.
